summary: Real-case regression of catalytic activity for engineered β-glucosidase variants.
what_it_measures: Standardized activity (`activity_standardized`) across β-glucosidase B variants.
assay_method: Experimental activity measurements on β-glucosidase variants in the Protein Engineering Tournament's supervised event.
provenance: A 'real_case' β-glucosidase dataset from the Align Foundation tournament; one random split, stratified on the target.
when_to_use: Applied activity ranking within one enzyme family; realistic directed-evolution setting for β-glucosidase.
caveats: Small, single-scaffold campaign; one random split, stratified on the target. Standardized target (MAE in standardized units).

citations.authors: The Protein Engineering Tournament (Align to Innovate)
citations.title: Results of the Protein Engineering Tournament: An Open Science Benchmark for Protein Modeling and Design
